unit: Students can welcome a guest, introduce someone, make basic small talk, and politely offer a drink.
objective: Introduce family members or colleagues to a guest.

title: Warm-up
subtitle: Let's talk about guests and family.
question: Who do you introduce when guests visit your home?
starters: When I have guests over, I introduce my...

title: Useful language (part 1)
teacher_instructions: Read each word aloud and have the student repeat it.
Read the definitions and example sentences.
Ask the check questions to confirm understanding.
Ask the student to make a sentence using one of the words.

words.check: Who is older, you or your father?

words.definition: A boy or man who shares the same parents as you.
words.check: Is a brother a boy in your family or a man at work?

title: Useful Language (Part 2)
teacher_instructions: Read each word aloud and have the student repeat it.
Read the definition and example sentence.
Ask the check question to confirm understanding.
Ask the student to make a sentence using one of the words.

words.definition: A person you know well and like.
words.check: Is a friend someone you know well, or someone you don't know?
Do you usually see a colleague at home or at work?

title: Conversation Builder
goal: Learn how to introduce people to a guest.

linkers.use: Use this to introduce someone to your guest.
Use this to explain your relationship to a man or boy.
Use this to introduce someone in a friendly way.

model:
Student: Hello! Meet my colleague, Sarah.
Tutor: It's nice to meet you, Sarah.
Student: Oh, and this is John. He is my brother.

your_turn.teacher: Hi! It's great to be here.
your_turn.student: Hello! [Use the phrases to introduce your father or a friend.]

title: Let's Practice
teacher_question: Imagine I am a guest at your home or office. Please introduce three people to me. You can introduce your father, brother, friend, or colleague. Use the phrases below to help you.

title: Real-world scenario
problem: The tutor is visiting your home or office. Welcome them and introduce your imaginary colleague or brother.
mission: Introduce your colleague or brother using 'This is my...' or 'Meet my...'.
start: Hi! It's great to see you. Thanks for having me.

title: Wrap-up
recap: Chunks: This is my... / He is my... / Meet my...
Skill: Introduce family members or colleagues to a guest.
final_task: Use one of today's phrases to introduce your friend to your tutor.
challenge: Try introducing a friend or family member in English this week.
